name: renderinvoice
description: RenderInvoice monorepo - web site + workers/ submodule

scripts.deploy:web: pnpm --dir web install && pnpm --dir web deploy
scripts.worker:deploy: pnpm --dir workers/cf-worker install && pnpm --dir workers/cf-worker exec wrangler deploy
scripts.test: pnpm test:markdown && pnpm test:autosize && pnpm test:web && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:worker && pnpm test:security:worker
